input.explanation: No. The error in the incident was the ZeroDivisionError at src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47, inside average_spend_per_item_this_month. That function lives in this repository, and the patch fixes it here: a shopper with no purchases this month now gets 0 instead of an exception. The fix applies whenever a request reaches the page with use_monthly_summary true, whichever flags turn that on and wherever they are evaluated. Nothing outside this repository has to change. The legacy-checkout-fallback flag doesn't appear in this code at all. Leaving it as it is or switching it off again is a rollout decision, and once this patch is in, that decision no longer leads to this error.
